title: gse-deep-nfl-methods-corpus-2026
universal_lens: A unified framework merging Bradley-Terry and Elo models via structured log-odds, enabling pairwise win probability estimation through online gradient ascent. A unified framework integrating scoring dynamics, network-based team ratings, and stochastic event modeling to characterize competitive football performance.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian conformal inference maps structured log-odds to calibrated confidence intervals for team rating uncertainty in GSI's probabilistic engine. Bayesian inference of team strength and match outcomes using network-based win-loss scores and probabilistic scoring models derived from play-type data.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning in GSE leverages the two-stage training pipeline to adapt ratings dynamically during game states, updating team strength based on real-time performance. Situational reasoning engine mapping real-time game states through dynamic play-type scoring, player tracking, and event detection from social media streams.
